excerpts.text: **Mount Hood** is an active [stratovolcano](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stratovolcano "Stratovolcano") in the [Cascade Range](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cascade_Range "Cascade Range") and is a member of the [Cascade Volcanic Arc](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cascade_Volcanic_Arc "Cascade Volcanic Arc"). It was formed by a [subduction](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Subduction "Subduction") zone on the [Pacific Coast](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/West_Coast_of_the_United_States "West Coast of the United States") and rests in the [Pacific Northwest](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pacific_Northwest "Pacific Northwest") region of the United States. It is located about 50 miles (80 km) east-east-southeast of [Portland](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Portland,_Oregon "Portland, Oregon"), on the border between [Clackamas](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Clackamas_County,_Oregon "Clackamas County, Oregon") and [Hood River](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hood_River_County,_Oregon "Hood River County, Oregon") counties, and forms part of the [Mount Hood National Forest](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mount_Hood_National_Forest "Mount Hood National Forest"). With a summit elevation of 11,249 feet (3,429 m),[[1]](#cite_note-ngs-1) it is the highest mountain in the U.S. state of [Oregon](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Oregon "Oregon") and is the fourth highest in the [Cascade Range](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cascade_Range "Cascade Range").[[6]](#cite_note-Swanson-6)
